ارتكبا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَكَبَا (irtakabā) /ir.ta.ka.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# اُرْتُكِبَا (urtukibā) /ur.tu.ki.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# اِرْتَكِبَا (irtakibā) /ir.ta.ki.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
